import sys

MAXN = 510
nodes, edges, mod = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())
C = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
f1_array = [0] * (MAXN)
f2_array = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
g1_array = [0] * (MAXN)
g2_array = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]

# Compute binomial coefficients modulo mod
for i in range(nodes + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j == 0:
            C[i][j] = 1
        else:
            C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod

# Initialize f1_array, g1_array
f1_array[0] = 1
for i in range(1, nodes + 1):
    f1_array[i] = 0
    g1_array[i] = 0
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f1_array[i] = (f1_array[i] + f1_array[j - 1] * f1_array[i - j] * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
        temp = ((f1_array[j - 1] * g1_array[i - j]) + (g1_array[j - 1] * f1_array[i - j])) % mod
        temp = (temp * (i + 1)) % mod
        g1_array[i] = (g1_array[i] + (f1_array[j - 1] * f1_array[i - j] * (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) + temp) * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
    f1_array[i] = ((i + 1) * f1_array[i]) % mod

# Initialize g2_array and f2_array
g2_array[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, nodes + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, edges) + 1):
        f2_array[i][j] = f2_array[i - 1][j]
        g2_array[i][j] = g2_array[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            temp_f = f2_array[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            f2_array[i][j] = (f2_array[i][j] + temp_f * f1_array[k] * C[j][k]) % mod
            temp_g = f2_array[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            g_part = (temp_g * g1_array[k] + (g2_array[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 0) * f1_array[k]) % mod
            g2_array[i][j] = (g2_array[i][j] + g_part * C[j][k]) % mod

print(g2_array[nodes][edges])
